01ABOUT ME

Simple ideas,
made meaningful.

Hello, I’m Sandhya, a passionate and creative graphic designer with strong expertise in Adobe Illustrator. I love transforming simple ideas into creative, attractive and meaningful visual designs.

My work combines creativity, attention to detail, typography, colour and clean composition to create designs that connect with people. I enjoy making digital graphics, artwork and visual identities that carry a clear message.

I started my graphic design journey in 2020 and have continued developing my skills in creative design, Illustrator, branding, logo design and social media design.

LEGAL

Privacy Policy.

LAST UPDATED: 31 OCTOBER 2026

This website is the portfolio of CraftArts Studio, founded by Sandhya. This policy explains what information we collect when you use the site, why we collect it, and the choices you have.

1. Information we collect

We only collect information that you choose to send us through the Project Enquiry form or by contacting us directly:

  • Your name
  • Your email address
  • The service you are interested in
  • The project details you write in the message box
  • Your phone number or WhatsApp details, if you message or call us

We do not ask for payment details, passwords or any sensitive personal information through this site.

2. How we use your information

  • To reply to your enquiry and discuss your project
  • To prepare quotes and deliver design services you request
  • To keep a record of enquiries so that we can follow up

We do not sell, rent or trade your information, and we do not use it for advertising.

3. Where your information is stored

When you submit the enquiry form, your details are saved in a private Google Sheet owned by CraftArts Studio, using Google services. Google processes this data on our behalf under its own terms and privacy policy. Only CraftArts Studio has access to the sheet.

4. Cookies and tracking

This site does not use cookies, analytics or advertising trackers of its own.

5. Third-party services

Some links on this site take you to other services, such as WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and email apps. Once you leave this site, those services handle your data under their own privacy policies, and we are not responsible for their practices.

6. How long we keep your information

We keep enquiry details only as long as needed to respond to you, carry out your project and keep basic business records. You can ask us to delete your details at any time.

7. Your choices

You can ask us to show you the information we hold about you, correct it, or delete it. Just write to us at the email address below and we will respond as soon as we can.

8. Children

This site is meant for adults and businesses. We do not knowingly collect information from children.

9. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be on this page with its updated date.

10. Contact us

For any privacy questions or requests, contact CraftArts Studio at craftartsstudio3@gmail.com or on 9318352554.
